course_title: Religion & Contemporary Experience: Fortune-telling and Fate
subject: REL
course_description: Religion and contemporary issues of human existence, the role of religion in politics and international conflicts, or the nature of contemporary religious movements such as fundamentalism.
course_notes: (This course satisfies the Religion major requirement:- Theme. What does it mean to know something about yourself? How do we think of the future? This course explores the great variety of non-scientific knowledge, including practical experience with Tarot. This is a Humanties course, which means the cultivation and discipline of subjective value judgements. We will be looking at practices from China, Japan, Europe and America. We will consider Tarot, the Yijing, astrology (Chinese and Western), bibliomancy (prognostication with books), prophecy, scapulimancy, séances, spirit communication, and phrenology. Also gambling, insurance, magical scams, how state lotteries work. James Bond playing cards, peak creative experiences during divinations (which are also experienced by gambling addicts), the gambler¿s spirituality, how to read cracks in a bone, the limits of empirical knowledge, how to find out who you will marry, how to use a snail to see the future, and how to do things with stones.
